description: One <id>.ocr.toml: word-level OCR losslessly equivalent to a DjVu XML derivative. Generated from the Rust types in tools/src/ocr.rs by `scans schema` - do not edit by hand.

dpi.description: Resolution the page was scanned at.

engine.description: Producing agent and version, e.g. `ABBYY FineReader 11.0`.

h.description: Pixel height of the page image.

lang.description: BCP-47 code of the text, when known.

of.description: Id of the record this page belongs to.

page.description: 1-based page index within the scanned container, matching `.pN` addressing.

w.description: Pixel width of the page image.

title: Word-level OCR sidecar
